relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: He acquired a dual Bachelor of Arts degree in Sanskrit and Mathematics from Madras University (1944).

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: He was awarded the Pitti Muniswami Chetty Garu Gold Medal by Madras University for first rank in the Siromani exam with Advaita Vedanta as specialisation (1949).

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: He went on to earn his Master of Arts Degree in Sanskrit (Classical Literature and Alankara as specialisations) from Nagpur University (1951).

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: He earned a certificate in German from Vikram University, Ujjain in 1965.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: Venkatachalam started his career in 1949 as a lecturer in Sanskrit at Vivekananda College, Madras.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: From 1954 to 1966 he served as Assistant Professor/Professor of Sanskrit in Madhav College, Ujjain, MP.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: In 1966 he was appointed Principal of Government College, Barwani (MP) and went on to be Reader and Head of Sanskrit Department at Vikram University, Ujjain, MP a year later.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.role: Reader and Head of Sanskrit Department
relations.evidence: went on to be Reader and Head of Sanskrit Department at Vikram University, Ujjain, MP a year later.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: He was later appointed Principal of Government Post Graduate College, Shajapur, MP in 1972. He again moved to Vikram University, Ujjain, MP in 1974

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.role: Reader/Professor and Head of the Sanskrit Department
relations.evidence: He again moved to Vikram University, Ujjain, MP in 1974 to be Reader/Professor and Head of the Sanskrit Department till 1985.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.object: Scindia Oriental Institute at Vikram University, Ujjain
relations.evidence: Concurrently he became the Director of Scindia Oriental Institute at Vikram University, Ujjain, MP.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: From 1986 to 1989 he was appointed vice-chancellor of Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, Varanasi, UP.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: After his term at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, he was Director of Bhogilal Leherchand Institute of Idology in Delhi till 1992.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: He was invited to serve as the vice-chancellor of Sampurnanand Sanskrit University for a second term from 1992 to 1995.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.object: Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri Sanskrit Vidyapeeth
relations.evidence: Concurrently he was also honorary Chancellor of Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri Sanskrit Vidyapeeth, New Delhi till 1997.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: From 1996 to 1998 he served as the vice-chancellor for Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University, Darbhanga, Bihar.

relations.subject: Vishwanathan Venkatachalam
relations.evidence: Concurrently, from 1997 onwards, he was the Chairman of the Indian Council of Philosophical Research, Ministry of Human Resource Development, Department of Education, Govt. of India.
